_comment: OTA-234 — ingested from NPC_Task_Difficulty_and_TC_Payout_Table.docx + Faction_Task_Difficulty_Table_and_Payout_Table.docx. 8-tier difficulty / payout ladders the Arbiter uses to size out quest rewards. SHIPPED APP ALREADY HAS A REWARD SYSTEM (factionQuests, hunts, mysteries, storylines have authored TC + FP grants) so this is LORE ONLY — the Arbiter narrates payouts in these terms, but new authored quests can use the table as a balancing reference.

npcTaskTiers.description: Very easy tasks requiring little effort or skill.
npcTaskTiers.examples: Running errands, delivering a message, scouting a location, retrieving basic supplies.
Escorting a person through safe areas, gathering materials, negotiating a minor deal.

npcTaskTiers.description: Tasks involving mild danger or a bit of complexity.
npcTaskTiers.examples: Guarding a small caravan, collecting relics from ruins, persuading an NPC for information.

npcTaskTiers.description: Tasks requiring skill and posing some risk.
npcTaskTiers.examples: Investigating ruins, finding lost technology, confronting low-level enemies, protecting a target.

npcTaskTiers.description: Dangerous tasks requiring coordination and planning.
npcTaskTiers.examples: Infiltrating a guarded facility, stealing important data, sabotaging a rival's equipment.

npcTaskTiers.description: Highly risky tasks with a chance of serious failure or danger.
npcTaskTiers.examples: Tracking down powerful enemies, recovering rare artifacts from dangerous zones, negotiating under threat.

npcTaskTiers.description: Extremely dangerous tasks with high risk of injury or death.
npcTaskTiers.examples: Assassinating a powerful NPC, battling Etheric creatures, infiltrating a hostile faction.

npcTaskTiers.description: Nearly impossible tasks with great danger and reward.
npcTaskTiers.examples: Securing powerful Tartarian relics, taking down a faction leader, restoring an ancient machine.

factionTaskTiers.description: Very easy tasks requiring little effort or risk.
factionTaskTiers.examples: Delivering a message between faction leaders, collecting a common relic.
Exploring the outskirts of ruins, negotiating trade for minor relics.

factionTaskTiers.description: Tasks involving mild danger or challenge.
factionTaskTiers.examples: Investigating minor Etheric disturbances, retrieving a relic guarded by automated defenses.

factionTaskTiers.description: Tasks requiring skill and posing some risk to the players.
factionTaskTiers.examples: Scouting deep within Tartarian ruins, disabling mechanical sentinels.

factionTaskTiers.description: Dangerous tasks requiring coordinated effort and planning.
factionTaskTiers.examples: Rescuing an agent from hostile factions, retrieving a relic from a heavily-guarded location.

factionTaskTiers.description: Highly risky tasks with a chance of failure or serious danger.
factionTaskTiers.examples: Infiltrating a stronghold to steal powerful technology, repairing an ancient machine.

factionTaskTiers.description: Extremely dangerous tasks with high risk of death or failure.
factionTaskTiers.examples: Battling powerful Etheric constructs, negotiating with an elite faction under hostile conditions.

factionTaskTiers.description: Nearly impossible tasks with immense danger or difficulty.
factionTaskTiers.examples: Taking control of a dormant Tartarian city, retrieving the most powerful relics.
